blind_coordinates.meaning: X coordinates on which no three-point row and no Bose condition depends (zero columns of A): free at this order, unconstrained by the rows

reading: F: of 204 generators 15 vanish after the h-leg symmetrisation; for ALL 124 nonzero generators that pass, each piece is separately in N (lambda arbitrary), so the lambda test is vacuous on them; 62 of them are supported only on blind coordinates. 64 of the 65 failures admit NO lambda at all (1 needs lambda=-2). G: 28/33 admit no lambda, 5 need lambda=i/2. P: 132/134 admit no lambda, 2 need lambda=-2. The Q08 hand-built pieces are therefore not sigma-images of the stated Y for most generators: the defect is in the construction, not in the normalisation, and no single normalisation (derived or fitted) can repair it.
